scope: Mocked UI preview using intercepted responses; not an ioBroker, authorization middleware, encryption or hardware integration test.

results.name: Home status, limits, localized functions and desktop screenshot
Activation success clears synthetic code and displays Pro; request POST/header asserted
Activation failure clears synthetic code, displays sanitized error, preserves previous edition details and restores controls
HTTP 401 marks previously valid status unconfirmed/error, renders administrator-required message and releases busy buttons
HTTP 403 marks previously valid status unconfirmed/error, renders administrator-required message and releases busy buttons
Status code, UUID and function HTML payload remain literal text; no injected DOM or script execution
Missing-license status clears edition/limits; 360px mobile viewport has no horizontal overflow
No browser pageerror during mocked scenarios

closedFindings.originalFinding: Refresh HTTP403 preserved the previous green valid status beside an error message.
closedFindings.fix: The request error handler now marks the status unconfirmed with the error style.
closedFindings.retest: Passed actual Playwright assertions for HTTP401 and HTTP403 starting from a valid Pro status.
